name: Parmigiana di Melanzane (Eggplant Parmigiana)
steps: Wash and slice the eggplant into rounds. Place in a bowl, sprinkle generously with coarse salt and let rest 20-30 min to draw out the bitter water. Rinse and pat dry.
Heat plenty of peanut/seed oil in a pan. When hot, fry the eggplant slices in batches until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels.
Make the tomato sauce: heat olive oil and crushed garlic in a small pot. Add the passata and a pinch of salt, simmer 10 min, then stir in torn basil leaves and cook 5 more min.
Dice the mozzarella small and pat dry with paper towels to remove excess whey.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce on the bottom of a baking dish. Add a layer of fried eggplant, then more sauce, a generous sprinkle of grated parmesan, and scattered mozzarella cubes.
Repeat the layers (eggplant, sauce, parmesan, mozzarella) until all the ingredients are used up, finishing with parmesan on top.
Bake in a preheated fan oven at 180°C for about 30 min, until the surface is golden.
Remove from the oven and let rest a few minutes before slicing and serving.
